newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PENPIX OF PARAGUAY SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PENPIX OF PARAGUAY SQUAD.

text.p: Pen pictures of the Paraguay squad for Sunday's Copa America quarter-final against Brazil.

Jose Luis Chilavert. Velez Sarsfield. 31. Remarkable goalkeeper who regularly scores from free kicks and penalties and enjoys winding up opponents with provocative, outspoken comments off the field. Claims he is the world's best goalkeeper. Team captain.
Ruben Ruiz. Monterrey. 27. Lacks Chilavert's flamboyance although some claim that technically he is a better goalkeeper.
Francisco Arce. Gremio. 26. Full-back who is also a dead ball specialist and an excellent crosser. A key player for his Brazilian club, helping them win three major titles in the last three years.
Celso Ayala. River Plate. 26. Second choice defender currently substituting for the injured Catalino Rivarola. His height makes him a useful asset at free kicks.
Carlos Gamarra. International-Porto Alegre. 26. Tough defender who is recognised as one of the best currently playing in Brazilian football, where he is based.
Juan Carlos Villamayor. Cerro Porteno. 28. Returned to Cerro this year after an unsuccessful spell with Brazilian club Corinthians. Can play in either full-back position.
Estanislao Struway. Portuguesa. 29. Ball-winning midfielder who has been a regular national team member for most of the decade.
Juan Ramon Jara. Rosario Central. 27. Left-footed player based in Argentina, can also play at full-back.
Roberto Acuna. Independiente. 25. One of the most creative members of the squad, he has established himself as the team playmaker over the last two years.
Hugo Ovelar. Guarany. 26. Newcomer to the team this year.
Harles Boudier. Olimpia. 24. Midfielder who has the knack of scoring goals.
Jose Cardoso. Necaxa. 26. Having played for the national team in the early 90s, he has made a comeback after being overlooked for most of last year.
Derlis Soto. Guarany. 24. Forward who likes to put his weight around and has been rewarded with important goals for both his club and country.
Arisitides Rojas. 28. Despite his age, he is a relative newcomer to international soccer but has already scored important goals in the World Cup qualifiers.
